cards.title: Paragraphs with
cards.body:
`

` holds a paragraph of text. Each paragraph starts on a new line, with space around it.

hi.title: se paragraphs
hi.body:
`

` text ka ek paragraph rakhta hai. Har paragraph nayi line se shuru hota hai, aas paas thodi jagah ke saath.

cards.title: Spaces get squashed
cards.body:
HTML turns extra spaces and line breaks into a single space. To start a new paragraph, use a new `

`.

hi.title: Spaces dab jaate hain
hi.body:
HTML extra spaces aur line breaks ko ek hi space bana deta hai. Naya paragraph shuru karne ke liye naya `

` use karo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: One line uses a tag that does not exist. Tap it.
cards.code:
Pancakes

Mix the flour and milk.

Cook for two minutes.

bug.fix:
There is no `` tag. A paragraph is `

`, so line 3 should be `

Cook for two minutes.

`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Ek line aisa tag use karti hai jo exist hi nahi karta. Us par tap karo.
hi.fix:
`` naam ka koi tag nahi hai. Paragraph `

` hota hai, isliye line 3 `

Cook for two minutes.

` honi chahiye.

check.question: How many paragraphs does this show?
check.explanation:
Each `

` is one paragraph, and there are three.

hi.question: Yeh kitne paragraphs dikhata hai?
hi.explanation:
Har `

` ek paragraph hai, aur yahan teen hain.
